all174_policy_boundary.official_key_semantics: The official parser extracts algorithm, byte size and content checksum from git-annex keys; the router uses the exact manifest key.
all174_policy_boundary.conservative_future_redirect_rule: For a frozenEDF row accept only the fresh actual originLocation with exactHTTPS host, no username/password/fragment/port override, and exact /nm000250/objects/SHA256E-s<row.size>--<row.checksum>.edf path; fail if different. This is a strict new transport acceptance rule, not a claim that all174 current redirect paths were observed. Preserve original full size/SHA body checks.
all174_policy_boundary.credentials_in_query: Provider-issued signature is ephemeral delivery authorization; do not persist/log completeLocation/query or send it to any alternate host. Do not create client credentials.
